prompt: Best AEO/GEO agency for an arizona local business?
text:
For an Arizona local business, I'd narrow the search to agencies that understand both traditional local SEO (Google Maps/local rankings) and AEO/GEO (getting your business recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews).

I found several Arizona agencies worth considering. My shortlist would be:

## Best AEO/GEO agencies in Arizona

1. Cited Co

Best specialized GEO candidate

Scottsdale, AZ

Focuses specifically on AI visibility and getting service businesses cited in AI-generated recommendations. Particularly relevant for professional services, luxury businesses, real estate, med spas, and other trust-driven businesses.

Website: [citedco.ai](https://citedco.ai/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. DIAP Media

Best published pricing

Scottsdale, AZ

Offers dedicated GEO programs alongside traditional SEO. Publishes pricing from $800/month for local SEO with AI SEO included; dedicated GEO programs start at $3,000/month.

Website: [diapmedia.com](https://diapmedia.com/arizona-ai-seo/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

3. Search Recon

Scottsdale, AZ

Offers SEO and AEO with an emphasis on local service businesses, search visibility, and lead generation. Worth interviewing if you want local Google visibility alongside AI search.

Website: [Search Recon](https://searchrecon.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. LocalFi

Scottsdale, AZ

Traditional local SEO, website optimization, and newer AI visibility services. Offers an AI Visibility Audit.

Website: [LocalFi](https://localfi.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

5. Digitaleer

Phoenix, AZ

Established SEO and web-design offering with practical AEO/GEO education. Worth considering if your website and traditional SEO foundations also need work.

Website: [Digitaleer](https://digitaleer.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

These are candidates to interview, not independently verified performance rankings. In particular, I'd ask each for actual AI visibility case studies.

## What I would look for before hiring

A good AEO/GEO agency should be doing all of the following:

- ChatGPT visibility: Getting your company mentioned when customers ask for the best businesses in your category and location.
- Google AI Overviews: Improving your chances of being referenced in AI-generated Google answers.
- Perplexity and Gemini: Building visibility across multiple AI platforms.
- Local authority: Optimizing Google Business Profile, reviews, citations, and local business information.
- Content strategy: Creating authoritative content that AI systems can understand, trust, and reference.
- Measurement: Tracking actual brand mentions, citations, and recommendations across relevant customer searches.

Be careful with agencies that simply rename traditional SEO as GEO and charge more.
